dct_description_sm: This data set represents a sedimentary analysis and a stratigraphic representation of a post-glacial forced marine regression in a macrotidal environment.  The goal of this research is to provide information on superficial deposits in the area of Kangirsuk, in order to determine permafrost conditions and caracteristics.  Ultimately, this set of data is part of a greater study of permafrost conditions in order to provide risk-assessment maps of permafrost vulnerability to climate change for the community of Kangirsuk. The data were used for M. Paquette B.Sc. Honor thesis in geomorphology.
dct_title_s: Stratigraphic and Grain-size data in Kangirsuk, Nunavik, Qubec.
